sources.title: dots3-note Preview - studio.dots.ai
sources.snippet: In dots3-note Preview, we began by building a multimodal foundation capable of understanding text, images, and audio. We then strengthened the model's reasoning and problem-solving abilities on closed, verifiable tasks. Across multiple benchmarks, it matches or even surpasses models several times its size.

sources.title: GitHub - studio-dots-ai/dots3-note-prev: dots3 note preview
sources.snippet: Model Introduction dots3-note preview is the first open-weight model in the dots3 family. It is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 280B total parameters, 16B activated parameters, and support for a context length of up to 512K tokens. The model can understand text, images, video, and audio, and produces text outputs.

sources.title: GitHub - tpurtell/dots-note-sm12x-2x
sources.snippet: The BF16 checkpoint interleaves layers across all 131 model shards; file-level layer partitioning does not reduce transfer volume. The current run replays calibration prompts on rhea and distributes K4 expert projection work across rhea and moa. The cross-host K4 kernel and checkpoint-reuse path passed a live projection test.

sources.title: dots-studio/dots3-note-prev - ZenMux
sources.snippet: dots3-note-prev is a preview large language model designed for general conversation and complex tasks, with a focus on instruction following, reasoning, code generation, and multilingual interaction.

sources.title: Dots3-Note Preview (free) - API Pricing & Providers | OpenRouter
sources.snippet: Dots3-Note Preview is an open-weight mixture-of-experts model from Dots Studio, with 16B active parameters out of 280B total. It is the lightest model in the Dots 3 family and is suited for reasoning, coding, multimodal understanding, long-context processing, and multi-step agent workflows.
